correctness.rationale: For all integer m>=2 and a>=1, the full vertex set follows from total unimodularity of the path stable-set matrix and conditional within-block color sampling. The exact vertex-distance identity B+sum_I(1-2p_i/a) reduces the sphere to a weighted path independent-set problem. Even m has a cardinality bound; odd m has an explicit positive edge-weight dual certificate, with strict slack beyond a=m+1 and special all-contact case a=1. A convex barycenter of actual contact vertices gives global optimality/unique center by the variance identity; strict convexity excludes nonvertex contacts. Exact rational verifier evaluated 707576 assertions across 274 configurations and a separate 70-solve numerical QP, but these are not infinite proofs. All boundary cases a=1 and a=m+1 were reconstructed.
